snippet.title: Illusive Domain - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3692670/Illusive_Domain/

Illusive Domain is a parry-focused boss rush action game. 
Deflect, dodge, and parry your way through your opponents in fast-paced boss rush action as you fight to escape this sealed realm of endless battle.

Illustrations: https://x.com/mok4suke
Music: @uniquegear
